Dat  or directions COURT'S OR JUDGE'S ORDERS No. e  and Registrar's  order with  Signatures  WPCRL No. 1753 of 2025  Hon'ble Ashish Naithani, J.
Mr. B.S. Negi, learned counsel for the Petitioner.
2. Mr. Vikash Uniyal, learned Brief Holder for the State of Uttarakhand.

3. The present Writ Petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India has been filed with the following prayers:-
"(i) Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus directing the respondents not to arrest/take any coercive measure against the petitioner pursuant to the impugned FIR No. 0027/2025 dated 16.12.2025, under Section 376, 506 IPC,
registered at P.S. Gopeshwar, Chamoli.

(ii) Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus directing the respondents not to arrest/take any coercive measure against the petitioner pursuant to the impugned FIR No. 0027 of 2025 dated 16.12.2025, under Sections 376 and 506 IPC, registered at Police Station Gopeshwar, Chamoli. "
4. The Petitioner has also filed a Stay Application, being I.A. No. 01 of 2025, seeking a stay on his arrest in pursuance of FIR No. 0027 of 2025 dated 16.12.2025, for the offences punishable under Sections 376 and 506 IPC, registered at Police Station Gopeshwar, Chamoli, during the pendency of the present Criminal Writ Petition.
5.

Learned State Counsel, however, referring to the FIR, submits that the Petitioner, who is stated to be the brother- in-law of the Respondent and already married, allegedly established physical relations with the Respondent, and that a child was consequently born due to such alleged physical exploitation.
6. The Petitioner refutes the submission made by learned State Counsel, contending that the FIR pertains to an incident that allegedly occurred five years ago, and with regard to the child, no proof such as a forensic report or any other credible material has been placed on record.
WPCRL/1753/2025 on 24 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/72364587/
1 7.
8. Issue notice to the Respondent No. 3. Steps to be taken within a week.

9. Let the objections be filed by the Respondents.
10.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, as an interim measure, it is directed that till the next date of listing, no coercive action shall be taken against the Petitioner, subject to the Petitioner extending full cooperation in the proceedings before the Investigating Agency and the Court below, failing which the interim relief so granted shall stand automatically vacated.
11. The Stay Application stands disposed of accordingly.

12. List this case on 16.03.2026.
(Ashish Naithani, J.) 24.12.2025 Shiksha WPCRL/1753/2025 on 24 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/72364587/
